message.content:
Sure! To help me find the right information, could you let me know:

1. Which meeting are you referring to? (If you have the meeting ID handy, that would be great.)
2. When you say “tasks,” do you mean tasks that were assigned to you during this meeting, or tasks in your personal task list?

Once I have those details, I’ll be able to look up whether you have any pending tasks.
